systematicIssues: The requested data/agent_library README/manifest/proposal-template files are absent on current main, so the current S6 proposal structure was used as the compatibility contract.

A material share of shard-0 rows have only social/third-party public traces or ambiguous generic names; without a safely established first-party exact-branch source they remain blocked rather than inferred.
Chain-wide recommendation semantics is not enough when exact branch applicability cannot be verified.
Recommendation text applying to beverages, categories, courses, reservations, or seasonal slots is not automatically promoted to a concrete recommended dish.
